# Tekloria (Digital Engineering & Development Studio)

> Tekloria is a premier technology studio providing freelance website development, custom mobile applications (iOS & Android), business-related websites, e-commerce stores, and enterprise ERP solutions for modern businesses worldwide.

- Website: https://www.tekloria.in/
- Headquarters: Hyderabad, Telangana, India
- Contact Email: contact@tekloria.in
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 85209 50487
- Primary Domain: https://www.tekloria.in/

## Core Specializations

1. **Freelance Website Development**:
   - Custom Single Page Applications (SPAs) & Server-Side Rendered (SSR) websites using React, Next.js, Node.js, and TypeScript.
   - Agile development model directly with senior full-stack developers without agency overhead.
   - 90+ Google PageSpeed Core Web Vitals optimization, semantic HTML5, and automated Technical SEO.

2. **Custom Mobile App Development**:
   - Cross-platform and native mobile applications for iOS and Android built with React Native and Flutter.
   - Offline-first data synchronization, biometric authentication (FaceID / Fingerprint), real-time push notifications.
   - Full deployment and release management on Apple App Store and Google Play Store.

3. **Business Related Websites**:
   - High-credibility corporate websites for healthcare clinics, real estate firms, legal & consulting agencies, fintech, manufacturing, and tech startups.
   - Lead generation funnels, booking systems, CRM integrations, and multi-language support.

4. **All Types of Websites & E-Commerce**:
   - E-commerce stores (Shopify, WooCommerce, custom headless storefronts) with Stripe, Razorpay, and PayPal gateways.
   - Interactive portfolio websites, digital landing pages, product launch hubs, and SaaS customer dashboards.

5. **Enterprise ERP Systems & Business Automations**:
   - Custom Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software, automated invoicing, inventory tracking, role-based access control (RBAC), and workflow automations.

6. **Graphic & UI/UX Design**:
   - Human-centered UI/UX design, Figma high-fidelity prototypes, comprehensive design systems, and digital visual branding.
